# Templates

Overview pictures of every template, one per channel. The editable templates are the Doefin Templates canvas and the Doefin Deck Template (see `../../links.md`).

- `templates-website.jpg`: the homepage hero and the article share card.
- `templates-social.jpg`: X header, LinkedIn cover, profile picture, figure card, app screenshot posts, quote card and carousel.
- `templates-email.jpg`: the newsletter header and a full issue.
- `templates-decks.jpg`: the eleven slide types.
- `templates-documents.jpg`: report cover, report page and one-pager.
